verdict.rationale: Abacum's own materials say it connects spreadsheet data into its governed source of truth. Its Excel connector lets users push and pull data between Excel and Abacum, so spreadsheets are a documented data source. There is no detail on CSV file upload or on spreadsheets serving as a fallback when no native connector exists. Missing for 10: explicit CSV import/upload documentation, evidence that spreadsheet data is treated as a first-class source (mapping, refresh, governance) equivalent to connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can load a CSV or spreadsheet as a first-class data source when no connector exists

citations.quote: It connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet, and warehouse data into one governed source of truth
Push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum, eliminating copy-paste errors and ensuring everyone's working off accurate numbers.
Keep Excel in use, while leveraging the power of Abacum.
